patterns: PSC items are direct facts: immediate successors of Mauryas = Sungas, Brihadratha killed at army review by Pushyamitra, Kharavela = Jain king (Hathigumpha).
Literary links recur: Malavikagnimitram = love story of Agnimitra, son of Pushyamitra.
Trap pairs: Rudradaman-Nanaghat (wrong; Nanaghat = Naganika), Hathigumpha is at Udayagiri not Khandagiri.
AP angle: Satavahanas as Mauryan feudatories; Erragudi/Rajula Mandagiri edicts.
App adds historiography (Shastri/Kosambi/Thapar theory matching) that APPSC rarely tests.
